disclosure.header: scope: xrpl-mc | the daily freeze timer ran on past the one cohort it was built to grade | stated 2026-09-04
disclosure.immutability: No published manifest is edited, withdrawn, or deleted by this addendum. All 33 pre-registration manifests, the cohort genesis record, the resolved ledger, and the genesis verdict STAND AS PUBLISHED. This is a new dated artifact that states what the existing ones are. The 414 instrumentation predictions remain publicly fetchable and independently hashable exactly as before; anyone who has already cited them is unaffected.
disclosure.summary: The XRPL-MC daily freeze produced 24 prediction batches between 2026-08-11 and 2026-09-03, all published as pre-registration manifests. Exactly ONE of them - the 2026-08-11 genesis cohort - was a graded experiment: it had an acceptance standard committed before its outcomes could be known, it was resolved into a canonical ledger, and its verdict was published. The other 23 batches, 414 predictions, were the freeze pipeline continuing to run. They have no acceptance standard, they will not receive one, and no verdict will be issued from them. They are instrumentation.
disclosure.what_is_NOT_wrong: No prediction was altered after the fact. No outcome was suppressed. No verdict was withdrawn. Every one of the 432 predictions was genuinely frozen and published before its window opened, and each remains independently verifiable from the public repository. The genesis verdict stands unchanged: UNTESTED, K=0. What is corrected here is a claim that was never stated explicitly and should have been: that a running pre-registration stream implies a coming verdict. For 414 of these predictions it does not.

what_was_graded.note: This is the whole of the graded XRPL-MC record. Nothing else in this chain has been graded.

what_was_not_graded.acceptance_standard: NONE - none was ever written for these batches

in_flight_at_issue.note: Their windows had not closed when this addendum issued. Maturity changes nothing: they have no standard either.

matured_but_unresolved_at_issue.note: Their 14-day windows closed between 2026-08-26 and 2026-09-03. They were never resolved and will not be.

what_was_not_graded.resolved: NONE - no ledger was produced for any of them
what_was_not_graded.verdict: NONE - and none will be issued

why_they_cannot_be_verdicted_now.reason_1_no_pre_committed_standard: A verdict requires an acceptance standard fixed BEFORE its outcomes can be known. The genesis standard certified exactly that (outcomes_known_at_issue: ZERO; issuance_strictly_before_maturity: true). No standard exists for batches 2-24, and for the 10 already-matured batches no standard written today could be pre-committed. That door is closed and does not reopen.
why_they_cannot_be_verdicted_now.reason_2_the_standard_is_single_cohort: xrpl-mc-genesis-v1-dryrun cannot be stretched to cover them. It pins one batch_root (488d922e...), one source_sha256, one exact 18-value y_prob vector, and one scalar maturity_epoch (1787695800). Its entire threshold apparatus - E=0.8921, HHI=0.35315, 1/HHI=2.8316, P(K>=4)<=0.0449, P(K=0)=0.3380, and therefore the K>=4 AGAINST threshold - is derived from that specific vector.
why_they_cannot_be_verdicted_now.reason_3_each_batch_re_forecasts: Every daily freeze re-runs the forecast, so each batch carries a different y_prob vector and therefore a different E, a different concentration profile, and a different false-positive curve. Applying the genesis thresholds to them would be applying a threshold derived from one prediction set to a different prediction set.
why_they_cannot_be_verdicted_now.the_principle: Deriving an acceptance threshold after outcomes are knowable is the failure mode the genesis standard's temporal_integrity_certification exists to rule out. Doing it here, retroactively, would contradict the one methodological commitment this chain has actually made.

disclosure.why_this_happened: The freeze half of the XRPL-MC pipeline is a daily timer. The resolve half was built for a single sealed cohort with a fixed maturity instant, and its unit was deliberately left with no timer and no [Install] section. After the genesis cohort resolved on 2026-08-26 the timer kept firing, and each firing added 18 more pre-registered predictions with nothing on the other end. That was not noticed until 2026-09-04.

outcomes_known_at_issue: All 24 prediction batches described here are already frozen and published; 10 have passed their 14-day maturity. This addendum states what the batches ARE. It reports no outcome, computes no verdict, and applies no acceptance standard.

manifests_empty_pre_genesis.note: Empty batches published before the cohort was armed. batch_root is the SHA-256 of the empty canonical form. Zero predictions.

manifests_with_predictions.cumulative_note: Each manifest contains every prediction to date, not only that day's 18. 20260811 holds 18 rows; 20260903 holds all 432. Each carries its own batch_root over its full contents.
